_about: Hidden areas (assets/osap-lock.js, Settings > Hidden areas). tools/seal_hidden.mjs seals every file matching 'sealed' for the owner keys and strips the hidden countries' parts from the shared files in 'strip'. 'owners' must equal OWNER in assets/osap-lock.js (tests/seal.test.mjs checks). A key is a setup code: a public key, safe to publish; only the owner's device holds the private half.
